_meta.status: PROPOSED for Agent 1 implementation. Not an engineering approval. All 75 register approvals remain PENDING.
_meta.mapping: resource_contract_mapping.csv maps every field below to its Stage 5.3A, Stage 5.4A and Agent 2 preparation source.
_meta.time_axis: Integer ticks from project_start as in 5.4A; tick must divide 60 and every calendar boundary (Task 3 finding N3).

principles: P1 No engineering defaults. Every capacity, calendar, demand, crew mode, release condition, throughput, segment rule and lead time is an explicit input carrying an input_state. An absent value is MISSING, never zero, never unlimited and never a library default.

P2 Two occupancy bases. working_time occupancy exists only during an activity's working segments. continuous_elapsed reservations run without a calendar from a start event to a release event and include nights, weekends, holidays, curing and every other hold.
P3 Durations are owned by Stage 5.3A. A crew mode's duration is the 5.3A productive estimate for that exact mode. Stage 5.4B never rescales a duration from a different crew size.

P4 Cost is owned by Stage 5.3A. Resource occupancy and reservations add no cost. BCCA already prices formwork timber and props as amortised material coefficients, so reservations must not create a second cost line.

P5 Counts are not derived from cost coefficients. BCCA per_unit amortisation values (for example CE00200 prop 0.01 u/m2) are not physical piece counts and must not be used to size reusable-asset demand.

P6 Explicit none is distinct from missing. A resource declared with capacity 0 and the explicit_none flag means the method does not use it; an undeclared resource that a reference requires blocks the activity (5.3A behaviour).
P7 Blocking is conservative. A missing or insufficient input blocks the affected activity and every successor; the solver is not invoked with relaxed or substituted values.

input_state.rule: Real-project scheduling requires user_provided_project or better for every field, and engineer_approved for every field with approval_required = true. hypothetical_fixture is accepted only when scope = hypothetical_fixture_only.

resource_class.labour_trade: Workers of one trade. Unit: worker (headcount). Renewable, working_time.
resource_class.equipment: Machines of one class (vibrator, crane, pump). Unit: machine. Renewable, working_time.
resource_class.inspector: Person or body authorised to perform an inspection. Unit: inspector. Renewable, working_time on its own calendar.
resource_class.reusable_asset: Formwork panel set, prop or shoring set. Unit: set or piece as declared. Renewable, continuous_elapsed reservation.
resource_class.supply_source: Concrete plant or delivery service. Unit: m3/h. Rate resource on a delivery calendar.
resource_class.consumable_material: Material consumed by quantity (concrete, steel, timber amortisation, release agent). Not capacity-constrained in 5.4B.

occupancy_basis.working_time: Occupied on exactly the ticks of the activity's working segments; released between segments unless retention_during_gap = retain.
occupancy_basis.continuous_elapsed: Occupied on every tick from start_event to the satisfied release condition, with no calendar.

availability.calendar: Capacity applies only on ticks inside the resource calendar; capacity is 0 elsewhere.
availability.continuous: Capacity applies on every tick (physical assets on site). Mandatory for reusable_asset.

execution_mode.source: 5.3A engine.estimate execution_mode; any other value raises insufficient phase evidence

Resource.description: One capacity pool. Pools are shared by every activity that names them.

resource_id.rule: Stable, unique, ASCII identifier. Distinct from display_name.

display_name.rule: Source label, for example the BCCA trade name 'OF. 1ª ENCOFRADOR'.

source_code.rule: BCCA labour or machine concept name/code when the resource is a catalogue trade or class.

explicit_none.rule: true only with capacity 0; records that the method does not use this resource (5.3A explicit_none_equipment).

availability.rule: reusable_asset must be continuous; all other classes must be calendar.

calendar_ref.rule: Explicit reference to a ResourceCalendar. 'PROJECT' is permitted only as an explicit choice, never as an implied fallback.

capacity_by_date.rule: Local ISO date to integer capacity override (for example reduced crew on a date). Absent means the declared capacity applies on calendar ticks.

approval_required.rule: Set by the engineering register owner. This contract assigns none.

ResourceCalendar.description: Same structure as the 5.4A ProjectCalendar so that build_windows can be reused.

working_windows.type: array of {weekday 1-7, start HH:MM, end HH:MM}
working_windows.rule: May be empty (resource never available); RC08d expects INFEASIBLE / NO_FIT then.

date_exceptions.rule: Explicit empty list when there are none.

CrewMode.description: A fixed combination of trade and equipment units that executes one operation simultaneously.

units.rule: Every unit is occupied for the whole duration of every working segment (simultaneous occupancy).

ActivityResourceRequirement.description: Per activity: the eligible modes, each with the 5.3A duration estimated for that mode.

modes.rule: At least one eligible mode. Multi-mode requires one 5.3A estimate per mode (P3).

productive_minutes.rule: 5.3A productive_hours x 60 for this mode; rounded up to the tick by the solver.

worker_hours_by_trade.rule: 5.3A demand; used for the consistency check units x scheduled hours >= worker hours.

allowed_hours.rule: Activity-specific window intersected with the resource calendars. Kept for 5.4A parity; supply windows belong on the SupplySource calendar.

InspectorRequirement.description: An inspection is a working-time activity (5.4A kind = inspection) that occupies an inspector and produces a pass event.

pass_event_id.rule: Gates successors through an inspection_pass event.

pass_status.rule: missing projects a conditional schedule (5.4A strength-release pattern); failed blocks successors.

Reservation.description: Continuous elapsed-time occupancy of a reusable asset from a start event to a release condition. Used for formwork panels, props and shoring.

resource_id.rule: Must reference a reusable_asset with availability continuous.

quantity.rule: Explicit piece or set count for this element (P5).

start_event.rule: Normally activity_start of the erection activity (FORM).

covers_activities.rule: Every working segment of these activities must lie inside the reservation interval (validation V8).

ReleaseCondition.description: When a reservation ends. The reservation ends at the latest of all listed events plus the declared return lead time.

all_of.rule: Typical panel release: activity_finish of its STRIP. Typical soffit prop release: activity_finish of the supported member's STRIP, plus any strength_release event.

return_lead_minutes.rule: Explicit elapsed time before the asset can be reused (cleaning, transport). 0 must be stated, not assumed.

reshoring.rule: Back-propping or re-propping is excluded from the selected BCCA items. approved_with_ref requires a separate modelled activity and reservation.

event_id.rule: Same identifiers and statuses as 5.4A hypothetical_strength_events / release_events.

SupplySource.description: Concrete supply and delivery throughput shared by every pour that draws from it.

product.rule: Concrete designation, for example 5.3A concrete_specification HA-25/P/20/XC2.

calendar_ref.rule: Delivery window as a calendar (for example Mon-Fri 08:00-14:00).

max_volume_per_day_m3.rule: Absent means no daily cap is modelled; it is not assumed unlimited for a real project unless input_state >= user_provided_project states it.

concurrent_with_placement.rule: Must be true for 5.3A to use the rate as a placement-duration bound.

supply_resource_id.rule: null only when the activity's 5.3A record lists CONCRETE_DELIVERY in explicit_none_equipment (pre-staged supply).

pump_resource_id.rule: null only when CONCRETE_PUMP is explicit none.

fields.duration_rule: productive_minutes = 60 x volume / min(placement bound, drawn supply rate, pump rate), computed in 5.3A as capacity_bounds_hours throughput entries, never in 5.4B.

interruption.rule: Pours are split_allowed only with an explicit cold-joint authorization reference; otherwise non_interruptible.

ConsumableDemand.description: Material consumption retained from 5.3A for cost and procurement. Not a scheduling capacity in 5.4B.

stock_or_delivery_schedule.rule: Reserved. Stock-limited consumables are out of 5.4B scope; no constraint is generated.

authorization_ref.rule: Approval id or hypothetical test reference. Absent -> SPLIT_NOT_AUTHORIZED and the activity is treated as non_interruptible.

retention_during_gap.rule: release frees crew and equipment between segments; retain keeps them occupied continuously across the gap.

restart_overhead_minutes.rule: Explicit working minutes added to each segment after the first. 0 must be stated.

voluntary_pause.rule: false: work continues whenever the calendar is open (Task 4 reference semantics). true: the solver may pause inside an open window.

CapacityPolicy.description: Preflight checks run before the solver. Codes reuse 5.4A SchedulingError codes where they exist.

rules.when: A demanded resource, capacity, calendar, crew mode, reservation quantity, release condition or supply rate is absent or has input_state missing.
rules.action: Block the activity and its successors. Do not invoke the solver for them.

rules.when: A reference requires CRANE, CONCRETE_PUMP or CONCRETE_DELIVERY and the input neither declares it nor declares explicit none.
rules.action: Block (5.3A raises 'Missing compatible ... supply or explicit none').

rules.when: A mode demands more units than the pool's maximum capacity on every tick of the horizon, or capacity is 0 for a demanded non-none resource.
rules.action: Reject the mode; if no mode remains, NO_ELIGIBLE_MODE.

rules.when: Every declared mode of an activity is rejected.
A non_interruptible activity exceeds every window of the intersected calendar, or a resource calendar is never open in the horizon.
split_allowed without authorization_ref or segment rules.
A release condition names an activity or event that does not exist, or that cannot follow the start event.
rules.action: Block the reservation and every covered activity.

rules.when: A release depends on a strength or inspection event with status missing.
rules.action: Project the schedule with the condition flagged; it is not a releasable schedule.

rules.when: A calendar boundary, duration grid or tick does not align.
No schedule meets a declared deadline.
rules.action: Report the deadline and the implicated chain; never return a relaxed schedule.

validation_rules.rule: Every resource_id named by a mode, inspection, reservation or pour demand exists in Resource.
explicit_none = true implies capacity = 0, and such a resource is never demanded.
reusable_asset resources use availability continuous; all others use calendar with an explicit calendar_ref.
For each activity and mode: units[trade] x scheduled_hours >= worker_hours_by_trade[trade] and units[class] x scheduled_hours >= machine_hours_by_class[class] (5.3A reserved hours consistency).
Mode units equal the 5.3A worker_capacity_by_trade plus equipment_capacity_by_class for the estimate that produced productive_minutes.
Elapsed holds (curing, strength release) demand no working_time resource (5.4A rule).
Reservation start_event precedes every event in release_condition.all_of in the dependency graph.
Every working segment of covers_activities lies inside [start_event, release]. A FORM-to-STRIP reservation therefore spans the pour, curing, strength release and stripping.
At every tick: sum of working_time demands <= capacity on that tick (0 off calendar); sum of reservation quantities <= reusable_asset capacity.
No reservation, inspector occupancy or supply draw produces a cost line (P4).
Tick divides 60 and every calendar and supply boundary.

solver_semantics.working_time: One interval per working segment; each interval contributes its mode units to a cumulative constraint per resource; capacity off-calendar is modelled as fixed blocking intervals or a time-varying capacity profile.
solver_semantics.continuous_elapsed: One span interval per reservation from the start-event time to max(release events) + return_lead_minutes; it contributes quantity to the reusable_asset cumulative constraint. It ignores every calendar.
solver_semantics.supply: Each pour interval contributes drawn_rate_m3_h to the supply cumulative constraint; the supply calendar restricts pour intervals.
solver_semantics.modes: Optional intervals per mode with exactly one present per activity; mode duration is fixed from 5.3A.
solver_semantics.reference_cases: RC01-RC11 and R0 in cpsat_reference_cases.json exercise these semantics; RC05a/b exercise continuous reservations.

controlled_fixture_instance.note: The Stage 5.3A / 5.4A fixture expressed in this contract. Values are copied from existing sources; nothing is added. Where no source exists the field is missing.

calendars.note: Holiday exclusion is the project calendar's; Agent 2 states only the weekday window.

resources.note: 5.3A declares 0 (manual handling, pre-staged supply). Agent 2's delivery window then restricts pour times only; max_rate_m3_h is null, so no throughput constraint exists.
5.4A applies the project calendar implicitly; this contract makes the choice explicit.
No source declares panel sets. BCCA timber per_unit is an amortised volume, not a count.
No source declares props on site. BCCA CE00200 per_unit 0.009 (beam) and 0.01 (slab) u/m2 are amortisation coefficients.

crew_modes.note: VIBRADOR comes from 5.3A equipment_capacity_by_class on the concrete activities.

inspections.note: 5.3A carries the pass only as criterion text ('Hypothetical passed ... checklist'). The contract requires an explicit pass event; the fixture needs one declared hypothetical_pass to stay unconditional.

reservations.effect: Under P1 a real project with formwork activities is blocked with MISSING_INPUT until panel sets, props, quantities per element and release conditions are supplied. For the hypothetical fixture, Agent 1 may declare the reservations excluded from the fixture model (input_state hypothetical_fixture, reason 'not declared in Stage 5.3A/5.4A sources') so that R0-15 and R0-5 keep their Task 4 results; the output must then list reservations as unenforced.
required_inputs: release_condition.all_of (panels: own STRIP finish; beam soffit props: B-STRIP finish, which the Agent 2 hypothetical rule orders after S-STRIP; slab props: S-STRIP finish)

split_policy.source: 5.4A fixture.adapt sets non_interruptible on every task

controlled_fixture_instance.consumables: All 5.3A materials lines retained unchanged for cost; no stock constraint.

open_items.item: The engineering register has no approval id for formwork panel or prop reservations, return lead time or reshoring. The register owner must add them before real release; this contract assigns none.
Inspection pass events are not present in 5.3A or 5.4A data; only criterion text exists.
Resource ids in 5.4A are BCCA display names with non-ASCII characters; the contract separates resource_id from display_name. The fixture instance shows one proposed id mapping.
Multi-mode crews need 5.3A estimates per mode; 5.3A currently emits one mode per activity.
5.3A supports supply throughput only as a placement bound (concurrent_with_placement). A shared rate pool across pours is new in 5.4B.
